title: Kids Mindfulness Meditations. A Podcast for Kids
author: Maryanne Eve Mental Health Social Worker
description: Kids Mindfulness Meditations is a podcast for kids aged 5-13yrs. FREE & PAID (SUBSCRIBER) CONTENT designed to help reduce stress, self soothe & settle children to sleep. Join Australian Mental Health Social Worker & Kids Mindfulness Meditation teacher, Maryanne Eve as her calming voice takes you on a journey via beautiful calming meditations DISCLAIMER-This podcast is a resource created by a qualified mental health worker, but it should not replace medical treatment/help SUBSCRIBE HERE-https://creators.spotify.com/pod/profile/kidsmindfulness/subscribe
